ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Burnstreak uses the camera to scan barcodes and take photos of your meals.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Burnstreak accesses your photos to analyze a meal from your photo library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Burnstreak uses the microphone so you can dictate what you ate.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Burnstreak reads your burned calories (Apple Watch / Health app) to calculate your net calorie goal.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Burnstreak does not write any data to the Health app.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your advertising identifier is used to show more relevant ads and to fund the free version of Burnstreak.
